snippet.title: Fortnite Festival Season 9 x Bruno  Mars - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Sabrina’s leaving the door open for the next Fortnite Festival Icon… Bruno Mars! This GRAMMY-winning megastar is expanding his record-breaking world tour with a stop in Fortnite. Fortnite Festival Season 9 is live now, and this is not a dream — the Season 9 Music Pass features the Die With A Smile Bruno Outfit based on the music video for “Die With A Smile”!

The World Tour Bundle is available in the Shop now, featuring:

Bruno-San Outfit: Take it 'round the world.
Bruno's Collection Back Bling: A perfect mix of retro and new.
Floating Notes Contrail: Drift on beats from Mars.
Bonde do Brunão Emote: Things are looking up!
Bonde do Brunão Jam Track: A souvenir from Brazil.
Key Charm Keytar: A real collector’s item.
Worldwide Bass: Make ‘em hear you everywhere.

Learn more: fn.gg/FestivalS9
